// Assessment-only actual-handler responses. No listener, real data or consumer reads.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/catalog"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/apps/gallery"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/internal/qualityplan"
)

type response struct {
	Status  int
	Headers map[string][]string
	Body    string
}

type routes struct {
	CatalogDetail, QualityList, QualityDetail, QualityBack, QualityAll, QualityAllDetail string
	QualityStale, CatalogRecovery, CatalogRecoveredDetail                                string
}

func main() {
	c, err := catalog.Default()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	plan, err := qualityplan.Default()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	q, err := plan.List("analytics.comparison", "core")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	stale := "0" + c.Revision[1:]
	if stale == c.Revision {
		stale = "1" + c.Revision[1:]
	}
	out := struct {
		CatalogRevision, QualityRevision string
		Routes                           map[string]routes
		Responses                        map[string]response
	}{c.Revision, q.Revision, map[string]routes{}, map[string]response{}}
	h := gallery.New()
	capture := func(path string, want int) {
		r := httptest.NewRecorder()
		h.ServeHTTP(r, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "http://127.0.0.1"+path, nil))
		if r.Code != want {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d, want %d", path, r.Code, want))
		}
		out.Responses[path] = response{r.Code, r.Header(), r.Body.String()}
	}
	for _, theme := range []string{"light", "dark"} {
		catalogList := url.Values{"q": {"analytics.comparison"}, "theme": {theme}}
		catalogDetail := url.Values{"expected_revision": {c.Revision}, "theme": {theme}}
		catalogPath := "/catalog/analytics.comparison?" + catalogDetail.Encode()
		qualityList := url.Values{"capability_id": {"analytics.comparison"}, "expected_catalog_revision": {c.Revision}, "theme": {theme}}
		qualityDetail := url.Values{"capability_id": {"analytics.comparison"}, "expected_catalog_revision": {c.Revision}, "expected_revision": {q.Revision}, "scope": {"core"}, "theme": {theme}}
		qualityListPath := "/quality?" + qualityList.Encode()
		qualityDetailPath := "/quality/core.analytics?" + qualityDetail.Encode()
		back := url.Values{"capability_id": {"analytics.comparison"}, "expected_catalog_revision": {c.Revision}, "scope": {"core"}, "theme": {theme}}
		all := url.Values{"capability_id": {"analytics.comparison"}, "expected_catalog_revision": {c.Revision}, "scope": {"all"}, "theme": {theme}}
		staleQuality := url.Values{"capability_id": {"analytics.comparison"}, "expected_catalog_revision": {stale}, "expected_revision": {q.Revision}, "scope": {"core"}, "theme": {theme}}
		recovery := url.Values{"q": {"analytics.comparison"}, "theme": {theme}}
		allDetail := url.Values{"capability_id": {"analytics.comparison"}, "expected_catalog_revision": {c.Revision}, "expected_revision": {q.Revision}, "scope": {"all"}, "theme": {theme}}
		out.Routes[theme] = routes{catalogPath, qualityListPath, qualityDetailPath, "/quality?" + back.Encode(), "/quality?" + all.Encode(), "/quality/core.analytics?" + allDetail.Encode(), "/quality/core.analytics?" + staleQuality.Encode(), "/catalog?" + recovery.Encode(), "/catalog/analytics.comparison?" + url.Values{"expected_revision": {c.Revision}, "q": {"analytics.comparison"}, "theme": {theme}}.Encode()}
		capture("/catalog?"+catalogList.Encode(), 200)
		capture(catalogPath, 200)
		capture(qualityListPath, 200)
		capture(qualityDetailPath, 200)
		capture("/quality?"+back.Encode(), 200)
		capture("/quality?"+all.Encode(), 200)
		capture("/quality/core.analytics?"+url.Values{"capability_id": {"analytics.comparison"}, "expected_catalog_revision": {c.Revision}, "expected_revision": {q.Revision}, "scope": {"all"}, "theme": {theme}}.Encode(), 200)
		capture("/quality/core.analytics?"+staleQuality.Encode(), 409)
		capture("/catalog?"+recovery.Encode(), 200)
		capture("/catalog/analytics.comparison?"+url.Values{"expected_revision": {c.Revision}, "q": {"analytics.comparison"}, "theme": {theme}}.Encode(), 200)
	}
	capture("/static/app.css", 200)
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(out); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
